notes: Corruption cards. effectKey drives src/engine/corruption.ts enforcement.

cards.name: Reckless
cards.ability: When Sauron draws Peril cards on your turn, he may draw 1 additional card.

cards.name: Indifferent
cards.ability: When you draw Encounter cards, draw 2 instead of 3.

cards.name: Distraught
cards.ability: You may never have more than 7 hero cards in your hand.

cards.name: Despairing
cards.ability: You may never have more than 3 favor on your hero sheet.

cards.name: Isolated
cards.ability: You may not consult with characters or trade with other heroes.

cards.name: Hopeless
cards.ability: You may not take more than 3 travel steps during each of your future turns.

cards.name: Mistrusted
cards.ability: You may not gain more than 1 favor during each future turn.

cards.name: Cowardly
cards.ability: At the start of each future combat that you are involved in, you must discard 1 random Hero card.

cards.name: Greedy
cards.ability: When Sauron Plays a Shadow card on your turn, he may then draw a new Shadow card.

cards.name: Despondent
cards.ability: When you rest or are defeated, the left-most Sauron victory marker is advanced 2 spaces (instead of 1)

cards.name: Careless
cards.ability: Immediately discard 2 favor from your hero sheet. Then Shuffle this card and the discard pile back into the Corruption deck.

cards.name: Wretched
cards.ability: Your turn immediately ends, Sauron may than choose to move you to the nearest Haven. Then Shuffle this card and the discard pile back into the Corruption deck.
